code:
SELECT vendor_id, invoice_num, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM ap_invoices_all
GROUP BY vendor_id, invoice_num
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
caption: Group by BOTH columns — the same invoice_num from a different supplier isn't a duplicate.
The first occurrence gets rn = 1; every row after it is a duplicate.
